description: Decodes hex or base64 encoded ASN.1 binary data into a decoded ASN.1 value string according to the provided schema definition, ASN.1 type name, and encoding rule (DER by default).

codec.description: The ASN.1 encoding rule used to encode the data. Valid options include 'DER', 'BER', 'PER', 'UPER' or 'CUPER', 'OER' or 'COER', 'JER', 'XML or 'XER' or 'EXER'. Defaults to 'DER'.

data.description: Hex or base64 encoded binary data string to be decoded.

dataFormat.description: Format of the input encoded data string: 'hex' or 'base64'. Defaults to 'hex'.

fileName.description: The name of the schema file. This should end in '.asn' (e.g., 'Rocket.asn'). If not provided, defaults to 'schema.asn'.

schemaContent.description: Plain-text ASN.1 schema definition. This must be valid ASN.1 syntax, typically starting with the 'DEFINITIONS' keyword and concluding with 'END'.

typeName.description: The ASN.1 type name (PDU) to decode into (e.g., 'Rocket').

userId.description: The user's email address to look up the asn1.io user account. If unknown, pass an empty string.

name: decode_asn1_data
